q.en: Find the average of the squares of the first 25 natural numbers.
q.as: প্ৰথম ২৫ টা স্বাভাৱিক সংখ্যাৰ বৰ্গৰ গড় নিৰ্ণয় কৰা।

explanation.en: The squares add up to n(n+1)(2n+1)/6 = 25×26×51/6 = 5,525, and there are 25 of them, so the average is 5,525 ÷ 25 = (n+1)(2n+1)/6 = 221.

q.en: Find the average of the squares of the first 30 natural numbers.
q.as: প্ৰথম ৩০ টা স্বাভাৱিক সংখ্যাৰ বৰ্গৰ গড় নিৰ্ণয় কৰা।

explanation.en: The squares add up to n(n+1)(2n+1)/6 = 30×31×61/6 = 9,455, and there are 30 of them, so the average is 9,455 ÷ 30 = (n+1)(2n+1)/6 = 315.17.
